mapper.select: SELECT A.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, B.UNITVALUE_DEC unitvalueDec, C.PUR_SPEED purSpeed, A.CCY FROM FIN_PRODUCT A,PRD_VAL_PARAM B,FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F16, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND A.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_01, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
SELECT COUNT(BONUS_PLAN_ID) FROM PRD_BONUS_PLAN_N WHERE BONUS_PLAN_ID = #{bonusPlanId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
SELECT CALENDAR_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
SELECT (TDY_ASSET_AMT - TDY_SHARE_AMT) TDY_UNPAID_INTINCEXP FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD WHERE CDATE= to_date(#{baseDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
SELECT max (CDATE) FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD WHERE TO_CHAR(CDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{delDate} AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
SELECT TDY_UNIT_VALUE TDY_UNIT_VALUE, TDY_SHARE_AMT, TDY_ASSET_AMT FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD WHERE TO_CHAR(CDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{vluRefDate} AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType = VARCHAR}

select pro.finprod_id finprodId, pro.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId, pro.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, deal.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, deal.ps, decode(deal.ps,'C9','现金分红','C10','红利再投','未知') psstr, DECODE(deal.ps,'C9',dealtotal.TRADE_AMT, deal.TRADE_AMT) tradeAmt, deal.share_amt shareAmt, deal.ccy, deal.settle_date settleDate, deal.REMARK remark from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD adddeal on deal.trade_id = adddeal.trade_id LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL dealtotal ON deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = dealtotal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT pro on pro.finprod_id = deal.finprod_id
and pro.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F16','F24') AND pro.PROFIT_TYPE = '01'
where deal.ps in ('C9', 'C10') and deal.trade_status = '01'
and deal.b_trade_id = #{bTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT NVL(deal1.FPRICE_AMT,0)-NVL(deal2.TRADE_AMT,0) amt FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT DEAL.b_Trade_Id, DEAL.FINPROD_ID, SUM(NVL(DEAL.TRADE_AMT,0)) TRADE_AMT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DEAL WHERE DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND DEAL.PS IN ('C9','C10') GROUP BY DEAL.B_TRADE_ID,DEAL.FINPROD_ID)deal2 ON deal1.TRADE_ID = deal2.b_Trade_Id and deal1.FINPROD_ID = deal2.FINPROD_ID WHERE deal1.TRADE_ID = #{bTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND deal1.ps = 'C8' AND deal1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND deal1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01, jdbcType = VARCHAR}

select FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.PERIOD_ID periodId, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.VDATE subCycleStartDate, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.Mdate subCycleEndDate, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId,
decode(#{regDateNum},0,0,PTL.AMOUNT*#{actTotalAmt}/#{regDateNum}) bonusCashAmt,
FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.BRANCH branch
from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION PTL ON FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PTL.Finprod_Id AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.BRANCH = PTL.BRANCH AND PTL.CDATE = to_date(#{vluRefDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID where 1=1 and PTL.AMOUNT > 0 AND FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}

select FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.PERIOD_ID periodId, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.VDATE subCycleStartDate, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.Mdate subCycleEndDate, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId,
TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT bonusCashAmt,
TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT bonusShareNum, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SHARE_AMT bonusShareAmt,
FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.BRANCH branch
from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION PTL ON FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PTL.Finprod_Id AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.BRANCH = PTL.BRANCH AND PTL.CDATE = to_date(#{vluRefDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.BRANCH AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} where 1=1 and PTL.AMOUNT > 0 AND FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
